description: Maya has a furnished room opening in her apartment and must make the final call on whether to sublet it to Jordan, settling the rent, payment timing, move-in date, and household quiet hours with input from Jordan and the other roommate.

shared_context.S1: Maya's furnished spare room will be available for an informal two-month sublet.
shared_context.S2: Maya will make the final decision about whether to proceed and will settle the terms verbally.
shared_context.S3: Jordan has expressed interest in taking the room, and Elena lives in the apartment.
shared_context.S4: Maya, Jordan, and Elena are meeting this evening to settle the arrangement and any household requirements.
shared_context.S5: As part of their usual house-meeting routine, Maya first asks each person for their concrete terms, then summarizes the proposed arrangement and asks each person to confirm it before she makes the final call.

PF1.text: Jordan's actual offer is exactly $900 per month, with exactly two months paid upfront, and a move-in date of exactly August 1.

PF2.text: Elena works remotely early each morning and requires quiet hours exactly from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. throughout the sublet.

acceptance_conditions: Maya must accept Jordan's sublet proposal.
The monthly rent must be exactly $900.
Exactly two months of rent must be paid upfront.
The move-in date must be exactly August 1.
The agreement must specify quiet hours from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., including equivalent natural phrasing.
A quiet-hours commitment targeting the apartment or Jordan must be logged.
Jordan's proposed terms must be cited as justification after Jordan states them aloud.

content_checks.C5: decisions['quiet_hours'] in ['10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.', '10 p.m. to 7 a.m.', '10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily for the full two-month sublet', '10 p.m. to 7 a.m. daily for the full two-month sublet']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['quiet_hours', 'quiet_hours_commitment'] and c['target'] in ['apartment', 'Jordan', 'Elena'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's private offer changes the settlement to acceptance at exactly $900 per month, exactly two months paid upfront, and an exactly August 1 move-in date, while requiring Jordan's stated offer to be cited.
Elena's work schedule changes the household term to exact quiet hours of 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. and requires a matching quiet-hours commitment.
